feasibility_reason: The mathematical content (local constancy of floor and ceiling off the integers, one-sided behaviour and continuity of round away from half-odd-integers, a ring-level formula for round, the characterisation of round x = n over fields, ceiling of a left translate) can be stated in plain mathematics while every consequential proposed choice stays hidden: the in-place restatement of continuousOn_floor/continuousOn_ceil to integer-valued maps without deprecation, the dropped and moved IsStrictOrderedRing assumptions, the encodings of the exceptional set (2 * fract x ≠ 1) and the left value (⌈2x⌉ / 2), the particular ring formula, the simp and fun_prop registrations, the names, and the public-to-private import change with its twelve downstream repairs. Exposed: the files touched (packet), the ceiling special cases for naturals, 1 and numerals (special cases the PR states), ring-level validity of the formula (the point of that result), and the names of the existing declarations the change concerns. Caveat: with no description, the purpose of the import maintenance cannot be stated; the brief names the places and leaves the purpose open, and the twelve import-only files in the packet hint that something stopped being re-exported.
brief_omits: The two helper lemmas (2 * fract x = 1 iff 2x is an odd integer; round x = ⌈2x⌉ / 2 away from half-odd-integers) are omitted as helpers; the brief gives round's left value mathematically instead. The specific ring formula, the TODO about redefining round (reduced to a neutral open question on the definition), attributes, typeclass hypotheses and the import specifics are withheld. model.md lists ContinuousOn.comp_fract'' as added, but the diff shows it only as context before the new end of section Ring; it is unchanged and not in the brief or ledger.
